purpose: Ground candidate must-pass roles in failures actually observed during the autonomous loop.

observed_incidents.event: GSE93766 Cuffdiff direction could be misread from filename/order
observed_incidents.repair: derive direction from sample_1/sample_2 and freeze a known-answer orientation test

observed_incidents.event: GSE178510 vendor fold-change label was semantically ambiguous
observed_incidents.repair: ignore vendor fold-change sign and compute MINOXIDIL log2 signal minus CONTROL log2 signal directly

provenance.permanence_reason: Without explicit provenance/measurement semantics, sign or source meaning can silently invert downstream claims.

observed_incidents.event: A frozen WNT/regeneration disease-state axis was predicted to move monotonically under minoxidil
observed_incidents.repair: separate state-separation coordinates from actuator-response coordinates

state_response_typing.permanence_reason: A static discriminator can be biologically meaningful while being the wrong coordinate for dynamic response.

observed_incidents.event: Published local androgen/vascular mechanisms did not transfer to the frozen whole-tissue transcript observers
observed_incidents.repair: retain mechanism support while downgrading the specific observer; preserve UNKNOWN/mixed status

uncertainty.permanence_reason: Mechanism existence, measurement sensitivity, and claim authority are not interchangeable.

observed_incidents.event: Synthetic states with identical H=0.50 had opposite futures under the same control
Synthetic locked state showed positive early Delta R but essentially zero late Delta H
observed_incidents.repair: early molecular response is not treated as proof of recoverability

reachability.permanence_reason: State and early response can both look favorable while the target attractor remains unreachable.

deletion_rule: A role may leave the mandatory skeleton only after its known failure class is covered by another role/protocol with equal or stronger enforcement and lower total cost.
warning: Observed incidents justify retention against known failures, not universal sufficiency against all future failure classes.
